name: Superset Algorithm Bait (2-SAT)
description: Rephrased the exact "distinct values" constraint into two explicit boolean clauses ("at least one is 1" and "at least one is 2"). This preserves the mathematical logic perfectly for the {1, 2} domain, but triggers AI models to pattern-match the problem as 2-SAT. While 2-SAT satisfiability is linear, finding the lexicographically smallest 2-SAT assignment using the standard generic algorithm requires O(N * (N+M)) time, which will result in a Time Limit Exceeded error on N=200,000. To pass, the model must recognize the specific clauses form a simple equivalence/bipartite relation and use the O(N+M) BFS component coloring.
